notes.subject: o gogometša
notes.rationale: רגע: ASV/JPS 'o gogometša' (stirs up) kgahlanong le Genevah/YLT 'o hierusa/kgotsofala' (calms) — magareng ga diphetho tše pedi.

notes.subject: Rahabe
notes.rationale: רהב: leina la mosthišo wa lewatle (Rahabe) kgahlanong le 'yo a ipelafalago' (KJVS 'the proud') — mme leina le bolokwa.

notes.subject: Rahabe
notes.rationale: Rahabe ke sephiri sa lewatle la myth — selo se se utilwego ka tlase ga sengwalwa.

translation: Ka matla a gagwe o gogometša lewatle, gomme ka kitsebo ya gagwe o thuba ⟨את⟩ Rahabe.
